install.agentRequest: 请先在 deeplugin.store 中检索 Registry ID deeplugin-5d9c48e09377f9e26f6b，展示来源和精确安装 spec，为 web profile 生成安装计划；等我明确批准后再安装。

posts.zh:
dsh-sound-cue 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。会话需要你操作（审批、提问或计划确认）以及任务完成时播放不同的短提示音。Web Audio 现场合成，无弹窗、无系统通知。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-5d9c48e09377f9e26f6b.html
posts.en:
dsh-sound-cue is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Short Web Audio cues when a session needs your attention (approval, question, or plan review) and when a task finishes. No popups or OS notifications.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-5d9c48e09377f9e26f6b.html
